topic: Cold-Start Evaluation Distortion via coldStartStrategy 'drop' vs 'nan'
problem_statement: Investigate the impact of PySpark ALS coldStartStrategy ('nan' vs 'drop') on evaluation integrity.
solution_or_decision: Controlled audit on 4 test rows containing 3 cold entities proves coldStartStrategy='drop' silently drops 3 out of 4 rows (75% data loss), whereas 'nan' preserves all 4 rows with explicit NaN predictions. Using 'drop' in Top-N evaluation artificially inflates recall and precision by discarding hard-to-predict targets from the denominator. In MoodGraph, 'nan' must be used and the evaluator must retain all positive targets in the denominator regardless of scorability.
evidence: Audit in run_m04_toy_als.py showed 3 rows dropped under 'drop' vs 4 rows preserved under 'nan'. Test test_09 PASS.
